Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered
by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening devices are available at this meeting. Ask a staff member if you

persons with a disability. Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring that
reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
Note: Commission agendas and minutes are available from the Staff Liaison or at the office of the City Clerk, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard during
